observed_facts: The agent called modify_pending_order_items at step 27, which according to policy can only be called once.
Because the item modification tool was used for the desk lamp at step 27, the agent could no longer modify the backpack in step 35.
inference: The agent should have waited until the user requested all item modifications or bundled multiple items into a single modify_pending_order_items call, since the tool can only be invoked once.
needs_verification: Whether the user intended to modify both items together or if the agent failed to anticipate the single-call limitation of item modifications.
parsed.summary: The agent invoked the single-use item modification tool too early for only one item, preventing subsequent modification of the backpack.
